sources.note: Main website. Overview of SYaaS model, product suite (clinical, ancillary, RCM), customer testimonials from VA/DoD, company positioning as reliable enterprise EHR.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. CHPL certification details, pricing model description (SYaaS scales by bed count), links to API documentation and real world testing reports.
Clinical solutions page. Details on charting, CPOE, BCMA, medical device integration, real-time alerts, configurable flowsheets, clinical surveillance dashboards.
Ancillary solutions page. Pharmacy (dispensing, compounding, timed flags), LIS (lab orders, results, specimen collection, blood bank), RIS/PACS for radiology/imaging.
RCM page. Patient access/eligibility, automated charge capture, medical coding with third-party encoder integration, claims/billing automation, KPI reporting.
About page. Founded 1983, privately held, ~166 employees, 40+ years history, 100% DoD deployment, VA expansions, zero-downtime track record, Landstuhl deployment.
Differentiators page. SYaaS bundled model, native AI integration, medical device data capture, advanced analytics, interoperable architecture, longitudinal patient record.

Blog post on market positioning. Describes comprehensive longitudinal patient record, unified virtual record across sites, positioning as affordable EHR alternative for community and academic health systems.
Press release on VA San Antonio PACU expansion. Unified patient record across critical care, procedural areas, and PACU. Real-time decision support and analytics.
VISN 6 (VA Mid-Atlantic) expansion to Med-Surg at VA Hampton. 53 sites, 584,000+ enrolled veterans. One-month go-live. Continuity of documentation between ICU and Med-Surg.
FedScoop article on $429M DoD contract for Essentris maintenance and decommissioning through Sept 2026 as DoD transitions to MHS Genesis. 59 military hospitals since 2011.

SoftwareFinder listing. 5-star rating (2 reviews). Lists supported settings: ED, ICU, ambulatory, OR, L&D, radiology, pharmacy, lab, rehab, behavioral health, home health/hospice. Notes high implementation costs and learning curve.
Fierce Healthcare article on completion of Essentris deployment at all 59 DoD facilities worldwide. 5,500+ beds, 24,000 physicians, 9.6 million beneficiaries.
Retired 2014 edition certification page for Essentris. Confirms CliniComp|EHR is the successor product to the Essentris line.
